name: ElephantStatus
fix_description: In sweep (0x35faa416), the function reads instant token balances or prices that can be manipulated via flashloan. Add TWAP-based price checks or restrict sweep to only be callable by authorized addresses with time delays.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step chain using four nested PancakeV3 flash loans to accumulate enough BUSD, then performing a price-moving swap before calling an unprotected protocol function and unwinding via another swap. While the core bug is simple access control on `sweep()`, writing the PoC requires understanding the protocol-specific price impact and coordinating several external calls/flash callbacks.
